df_cutin_key.design: CutinEnv native road, dense lane-0 traffic, and independent random native type labels. The nearest native vehicle behind the ego is kept as the key; its native label is preserved and its initial speed, target speed, and crossing response are set by that label. Aggressive keys approach at 10.5 m/s and accelerate after the ego starts crossing; Normal keys keep native cooperative IDM; Cautious keys yield. No occlusion vehicles are used: the key is available in the first synchronous observation for all 50 seeds. Other lane-0 vehicles within [-40,+250] m of the ego are removed to open a merge corridor; all outside traffic and labels remain native. Ego starts in lane 1 at 7 m/s, the cut-in to lane 0 is required, and completion requires x>=310 m. Only Full Model and Uniform Belief are run. No controller/reward/prompt change; the key response is type-scripted and variant-independent. Diagnostic recognition run: the controller receives the uniform prior, so the state trajectory does not depend on the prompt; only the logged prompt version differs between the v5 and v6 runs. This isolates prompt generalization from closed-loop feedback. Prompt v6b treats a sustained speed offset from both the ego and the same-lane stream as evidence when the target has no observable leader, instead of forcing abstention on constant-speed vehicles.
